breakdown.description: ΔG° = -RT ln K makes a negative ΔG° consistent with K > 1, not K < 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that a negative ΔG° (= -12 kJ/mol) implies K > 1 via the relationship ΔG° = -RT ln K. It explicitly ignores the contradictory stated value of K = 0.008 and concludes that K must be greater than 1, calculating K ≈ 127. This directly resolves the inconsistency where the original prompt incorrectly paired a negative ΔG° with K = 0.008 (which is less than 1).
